pick.headline: Reagan arrives in Moscow for his summit with Gorbachev

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Soviet Union, No. 104, 31 May 1988
evidence.snippet: …Presidium open. Comrades, there is just one issue on the agenda: Ratifi- cation of the treaty signed not so long ago by Mikhail Sergeyevich Gorbachev on the Soviet side, during his visit to Washington, and by President Reagan on the USS. side. I do not know whether you have any other point con- cerning our agenda. Since there are no other points, we approve the agenda which comprises just one question, but a question of exceptional importanc…
